name: What factors should I consider when choosing an ADU contractor?
description: Choose an ADU contractor with local experience, proper licensing and insurance, a strong portfolio, transparent pricing, and excellent communication skills.

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing an ADU contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an ADU contractor, prioritize experience with ADU projects in your specific area, like Huntington Beach or Yorba Linda. Look for a licensed and insured contractor with a strong portfolio and positive client references. Transparency in pricing, clear communication, and a comprehensive understanding of local permitting requirements are also crucial. A good contractor guides you through design, permitting, and construction efficiently.
